list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: ortho-methoxyphenyl-substituted cyclopentadienyl terbium–potassium chloride ate complex, THF solvate

material_class.structural_family: tetranuclear cyclopentadienyl lanthanide–potassium chloride ate complex

properties.summary: Ligand-sensitized Tb(III) emission is reported; the ortho-methoxy group does not coordinate Tb in this THF-containing structure.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Two equivalent dinuclear Tb2K chloride-bridged moieties join through K–Cl bonds to form a Tb4K2Cl10 core. THF oxygen, rather than methoxy oxygen, coordinates each Tb center.

synthesis.procedure: KHMDS was added to Cp(Ph2Ar-o)H in THF and stirred for 15 min. The resulting potassium cyclopentadienide was added to a TbCl3(THF)3 suspension in THF and stirred overnight.
synthesis.time: 15 min, then overnight; crystallization after several days
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Centrifuged, washed the precipitate with THF, concentrated the combined solution to 25 mL, layered with 40 mL hexane, and dried crystals under dynamic vacuum for 2 h.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Mononuclear bent sandwich complex; Tb is coordinated by two cyclopentadienyl rings, chloride, and both intramolecular methoxy oxygen atoms.

synthesis.procedure: BnK and Cp(Ph2Ar-o)H were reacted in THF for 15 min; the resulting potassium ligand was added to TbCl3(THF)3 in THF and stirred overnight.
synthesis.time: 15 min, then overnight; crystallization after several days
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Centrifuged and washed with THF, evaporated to dryness, dissolved in toluene, centrifuged, layered with hexane, and vacuum-dried crystals.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: THF-free tetranuclear ortho-methoxyphenyl cyclopentadienyl terbium–potassium chloride ate complex, toluene solvate

material_class.structural_family: tetranuclear cyclopentadienyl lanthanide–potassium chloride ate complex

properties.summary: Ligand-sensitized Tb(III) emission has a reported overall quantum yield of 0.63.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The Tb4K2Cl10 core resembles Tb1, but intramolecular methoxy oxygen replaces coordinated THF at Tb; potassium also interacts with a phenyl ring.

synthesis.procedure: Tb1 was dissolved in toluene, stirred for 2 h, evaporated, then redissolved in toluene for hexane-layering crystallization.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: recrystallization with loss of coordinated THF
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Evaporated to dryness, redissolved in 10 mL toluene, layered with 10 mL hexane, and dried under dynamic vacuum. The crystal contained six free toluene molecules, two of which were lost on drying.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: tetranuclear ortho-methoxyphenyl cyclopentadienyl gadolinium–potassium chloride ate complex, mixed-solvent crystal

material_class.structural_family: tetranuclear cyclopentadienyl lanthanide–potassium chloride ate complex

properties.summary: The article reports optical spectroscopy and luminescence for the gadolinium complexes, without a compound-specific numerical result in Table 2.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A C2-symmetric Gd4KCl9 core has four η5:κ1 cyclopentadienyl–Gd fragments, pairwise linked by chloride bridges and connected by an interstitial chloride. Potassium contacts four chlorides and two phenyl rings.

synthesis.procedure: Gd1 was stirred in toluene, evaporated, and recrystallized from toluene/hexane; insoluble material, presumed KCl, was removed during a further toluene dissolution and centrifugation.
synthesis.time: 2 h stirring; crystallization after several days; 2 h vacuum drying
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Redissolved residue in 15 mL toluene, layered with 15 mL hexane, decanted the resulting powder, suspended in 8 mL toluene, centrifuged, and layered with 15 mL hexane. The crystal included free toluene and hexane, some lost on drying.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: dinuclear ortho-methoxyphenyl cyclopentadienyl terbium chloride THF complex

properties.summary: Ligand-sensitized Tb(III) emission is reported; its 300 K lifetime is the longest among the tabulated Tb complexes.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Two Cp(Ph2Ar-o)Tb(THF)Cl fragments are joined by two bridging chloride ligands; ortho-methoxy oxygen also coordinates Tb.

synthesis.procedure: Equimolar Tb2 and TbCl3(THF)3 were combined in THF and stirred overnight.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Centrifuged, layered the solution with 15 mL hexane, and vacuum-dried crystals. Two free THF molecules per formula unit in the crystal were lost on drying.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: dinuclear ortho-methoxyphenyl cyclopentadienyl gadolinium chloride THF complex

properties.summary: Optical spectroscopy and luminescence of the gadolinium complexes are reported without a compound-specific numerical result in Table 2.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Reported as isostructural with Tb4: two monocyclopentadienyl gadolinium fragments linked by two chloride bridges.

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by the stated Tb4 procedure using Gd3 and GdCl3(THF)3 in place of the terbium reagents.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Following the Tb4 procedure, the reaction solution was centrifuged and layered with hexane for crystallization.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: toluene solvatomorph of dinuclear gadolinium complex Gd4

material_class.structural_family: toluene solvatomorph of a dinuclear monocyclopentadienyl lanthanide chloride complex

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: XRD-identified toluene-containing solvatomorph of the dinuclear Gd4 complex, retaining its chloride-bridged Gd2 molecular unit.

synthesis.procedure: Recrystallization of Gd4 from toluene produced rapid precipitation of the toluene-containing solvatomorph; no separate quantified preparation is given.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: THF-free tetranuclear ortho-methoxyphenyl cyclopentadienyl terbium chloride complex

properties.summary: Ligand-sensitized Tb(III) emission is reported; its branching ratio is the largest of the tabulated Tb complexes.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Four Cp(Ph2Ar-o)Tb fragments are connected by eight bridging chloride ligands. Loss of coordinated THF from the dinuclear precursor accompanies formation of this tetranuclear structure.

synthesis.procedure: Tb4 was dissolved in toluene, stirred for 2 h, evaporated, redissolved in toluene, and crystallized by layering with hexane.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Evaporated, redissolved in 8 mL toluene, layered with 12 mL hexane, and dried crystals under dynamic vacuum.

material_class.structural_family: tetranuclear cyclopentadienyl lanthanide–potassium chloride ate complex

properties.summary: The article reports optical spectroscopy and luminescence of its gadolinium complexes; a Gd6 single-crystal structure was not obtained.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The proposed Ln6 architecture is analogous to Ln1, but single crystals suitable for XRD were not obtained; the molecular structure is therefore unconfirmed.

synthesis.procedure: BnK and Cp(Ph2Ar-p)H were reacted in THF for 15 min, then added to GdCl3(THF)3 in THF and stirred overnight.
synthesis.time: 15 min, then overnight; crystallization after several days
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Centrifuged, washed precipitate with THF, concentrated solution, layered with hexane, and vacuum-dried crystals.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: para-methoxyphenyl cyclopentadienyl terbium–potassium chloride ate complex

material_class.structural_family: proposed tetranuclear cyclopentadienyl lanthanide–potassium chloride ate complex

properties.summary: Ligand-sensitized Tb(III) emission is measured, although a suitable single crystal for XRD was not obtained.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The authors propose an Ln1-like architecture, but report only microcrystalline samples and no single-crystal XRD structure for Tb6.

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by the stated Gd6 procedure using the specified terbium chloride, BnK, and para-methoxyphenyl cyclopentadiene quantities.

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Following the Gd6 procedure, centrifuged, concentrated, layered with hexane, and vacuum-dried the product.

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Centrifuged, washed precipitate with THF, concentrated solution to 30 mL, layered with 60 mL hexane, and vacuum-dried crystals.

material_class.structural_family: proposed binuclear bis(cyclopentadienyl) lanthanide–potassium chloride ate complex

properties.summary: Ligand-sensitized Tb(III) emission is reported; the 300 K lifetime is the shortest of the tabulated Tb complexes.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Assigned as the THF-free product of Tb7 recrystallization; attempts to obtain XRD-quality crystals failed, so the detailed structure is not established.

synthesis.procedure: Tb7 was dissolved in toluene, stirred for 2 h, evaporated, redissolved in toluene, and layered with hexane to crystallize the THF-free product.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Evaporated, redissolved in 7 mL toluene, and layered with 13 mL hexane.
